exit: 0
--- stdout
CDL.Logical.TrueDelay
  Delay a rising edge of the input, but do not delay a falling edge

parameters:
  delayTime : Real (required)
      Delay time
      unit: s; quantity: Time
  delayOnInit : Boolean = false
      Set to true to delay initial true input

inputs:
  u : Boolean
      Input signal to be delayed when it switches to true

outputs:
  y : Boolean
      Output with delayed input signal after it switched to true

notes:
  convention (delayOnInit): The open-control-library sets delayOnInit = true on every TrueDelay, against the CDL default false, so a condition that is already true at start-up must still persist for the full delay. The emitter never fills a default: write it.
  loop: Passes the current input through: a feedback loop through TrueDelay alone is an algebraic loop and the engine refuses it. Break the loop with Logical.Pre.

links:
  source at the pinned Buildings commit: https://github.com/lbl-srg/modelica-buildings/blob/a131864e4c4df22ebcd52bb8da439de0087ac365/Buildings/Controls/OBC/CDL/Logical/TrueDelay.mo
  help in the latest Buildings release (may drift from the pin): https://simulationresearch.lbl.gov/modelica/releases/latest/help/Buildings_Controls_OBC_CDL_Logical.html#Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Logical.TrueDelay
